keyframe_review.note: Reviewer's choice (a) applied. The Spanish list 'Segundos reinos de taifas' has 'taifa de Córdoba, de 1144 a 1148, conquistada por los almohades' (no ruler, no land; Jaén and Carmona have entries of their own), and the Abd al-Mu'min page has 'Responding to local appeals from Muslim officials, they took control of Cordoba in 1149', so the shape is held to 1149, not Cliopatria's 1151. The Taifa overview lists Jaén as a taifa of its own ('Jaén: 1145–1159 (to Murcia)'), so Jaén and Linares come out. 1144-1146 are not drawn: Cliopatria has no shape for them and the Yahya ibn Ghaniya page has the Almoravids defending Córdoba against Alfonso VII in 1146. No infobox area to compare (the English article, for the republic of 1031-1091, gives none).

notes: Cliopatria's Name 'Taifa of Córdoba' does not match its English Wikipedia article, which covers the republic of 1031-1091; the three shapes are 1147-1151 (15,320 km2), 1236-1240 (one grid cell) and 1241-1249 (nine cells containing Jaén). Repaired 2026-10-25 after the reviewer: (1) only the 1147 shape is drawn, cut to the province of Córdoba and held to 1149; (2) the 1236 cell and the 1241 Jaén shape are marked wrong (nothing drawn): the 1241 shape is Ibn al-Ahmar's Jaén, which emirate-of-granada draws and which Castile took in March 1246 (Emirate of Granada page); (3) the dossier ends in 1149, with the loss and dissolve to almohad-caliphate. Page support: the Spanish 'Segundos reinos de taifas' lists 'taifa de Córdoba, de 1144 a 1148, conquistada por los almohades' (no ruler, no land); the Abd al-Mu'min page dates the Almohad takeover to 1149 after 'local appeals from Muslim officials'. The two differ by a year (1148 or 1149); 1149 follows the Almohad and Almoravid dossiers. 1144-1146 is not drawn: the Yahya ibn Ghaniya page has the Almoravid governor defending Córdoba against Alfonso VII in 1146 and Cliopatria has no shape before 1147. The English Ibn Hamdin page and the Spanish Ibn Hamdín page do not exist (url_not_found), so no ruler is named. The Jaén half of the old shape belongs to the Jaén taifa (Taifa overview: 'Jaén: 1145–1159 (to Murcia)'), which has no dossier. For neighbours: almoravid-dynasty should date its loss of Córdoba to this taifa in 1147 (not 1149 to the Almohads) and almohad-caliphate should name taifa-of-cordoba as the 1149 counterpart; its 1152 'gain from taifa-of-cordoba' then covers cells this dossier no longer holds; crown-of-castile /ledger/1 (1236) needs its own holder of Córdoba. No area could be compared (the article has 'Area: not listed').
